caption: A large white multi-deck cruise ship with a dark funnel moves through calm mirror-like water inside a fjord. A steep shadowed cliff rises on the left, forested slopes line the right, and a snow-capped mountain stands under a pale-blue sky. The ship turns steadily as it grows in frame, shifting from a near head-on angle toward a broadside view with its bow pointing left. Rows of lifeboats become visible along the hull as the vessel enlarges. The bright reflection beneath the ship lengthens in step with its increasing size. The exhaust from the dark funnel changes from a short cloud drifting right into a taller, thinner column rising upward. The surrounding cliffs and peak remain fixed, keeping the visible change centered on the ship's position and orientation.
